title: Tooth & Tide is now on Steam
author: Comprehensive_Tax_15
selftext: I made a cozy beachcomber game where you collect shark's teeth and learn about sharks. I'm regularly updating and improving it and it's a fun collectathon. If you all want to check it out it is already released on Steam and I've had a fair number of sales for not doing any marketing. I need to update the trailer since I've done a graphics overhaul on the game, but I hope you all are willing to go take a look and if you enjoy it leave a review with any suggestions or just saying how you feel about it.
